events.title: Cross-vendor divergence -- fabrication-triage retrospective test
events.governed_run: AUROC of (D-1)/(V-1) vendor-collapsed divergence vs fabricated-vs-confirmed label (roc.py Mann-Whitney + auc_ci bootstrap); k_min=15, seed=20260719, n_boot=2000; secondary = (fabricated U misleading) vs confirmed
events.outcome: INCONCLUSIVE (primary n_fabricated=3 < k_min=15; secondary n=6 < 15) on 38 curated shared-referent slots. Structural finding: fabrications were mostly SOLO (single-vendor, invisible to a cross-vendor statistic), and the recovered shared-referent slots skew high-divergence across ALL labels (confirmed mean 0.807 vs fabricated 0.944) -> directionally consistent with the hypothesis but unmeasurable at n=3. Machinery validated (14 tests); the instrument accumulates forward calibration.
events.measured_ref: references/divergence-prereg.md (design of record); INCONCLUSIVE -- no aggregate number published; raw curated dataset private
